propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend runtime_checkable protocol because it is missing query_project and assert_env_ready, so isinstance(backend, Backend) is False.
The reconciler.backend config validator only permits {"jira"}, leaving the registered jira-datacenter backend unreachable through config despite the registry resolving it.
The backend-agnostic contract fixture in test_backend_contract.py is not parametrized over the DC backend, so the DC backend has never been held to the port contract.

An inbound apply under the DC backend mints a ghost identity with creation_channel='jira-datacenter', which is not in CREATION_CHANNELS, raising a ValueError that is silently swallowed while the pass still reports convergence.
The Jira-family import checker lacks a reciprocal rule preventing adapters/jira_datacenter/ modules from importing adapters/jira/, so DC-imports-Cloud violations pass.
The clean-core-wheel optionality check omits 'jira' from its absent-module list, leaving no CI teeth guaranteeing the base install pulls no DC dependency.
